requestTimeSafetyNet.statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / ALTER TABLE ... IF NOT EXISTS / idempotent indexes and seed inserts
requestTimeSafetyNet.execution: once per Worker isolate with shared promise; failed promise resets for retry
requestTimeSafetyNet.purpose: availability safety net while migration runner is not part of Worker startup

assessment: PARTIALLY VERIFIED - schema is migration-first with an idempotent per-isolate safety net. Request-time DDL remains a deliberate transitional safeguard; it can add latency/locks and is not a substitute for controlled migrations.
failureBehavior: Database permission or migration failure returns an API error; no destructive or partial schema rewrite is attempted.
ownerAction: Keep migrations in CI/deploy order, run migrate.mjs with the production DATABASE_URL before deploy, and remove request-time DDL after migration tracking and startup guarantees are established.
